NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "7276499F4F5BB086639B89BEE7A94ABC", "Long before the Exodus of legend, when the Gods still walked among the faithful, the Aelan priesthood consecrated a gate in the hills beyond the Aelan capital. Raised atop a cascade of mighty waterfalls and aligned to ancient celestial cycles, the Divine Gate of the Aela was inscribed with the edicts of Gods who foresaw ruin and built passage through it.

Centuries later, when the Harbingers fell and the Ancients returned, the empire faltered. Cities crumbled, temples burned, and the order that had once bound the world together unraveled. But the gate had endured.

It was there, beneath a shattered moon, that the chldren of Aela gathered. Some were nobles. Some were soldiers. All were refugees. And when the gate opened, they crossed into silence, carrying only what they could remember.

Now the stars are aligned once more. The gate has stirred, and the children of the Aelan legacy return to Verra, drawn home by prophecy, and burdened with the memory of a world lost.")
name: Riverlands_Sanctus
